# Objective

Add a **group view** to the overlay: instead of showing all (up to 841) 2-char
pills at once, the overlay opens with **≤29 dotted-line boxes**, one per
first-char label group, each with a single-char label. Typing a group char
reveals **only that group's points, labeled by their second char alone**; the
second keystroke fires the click.

Goals (user's words): more opportunity to view the text, less overlapping, and
fewer mis-types — "user must press the 1st label to know what's the next label"
(sequential disclosure instead of parallel 2-char typing from memory).

# Design decisions (confirmed with user, 2026-08-14)

1. **Fire at the 2nd label** — 2 keystrokes total, same as today. No recursive
   drilling (door left open if 2 levels prove too coarse on the box).
2. **Regions derive from the existing label groups** — boxes = bounding boxes of
   the current first-char label groups. Zero new point geometry: same points,
   same labels, same coverage (29×29 = 841) as today. NOT a zone-grid sibling.
3. **Drill view is the default** — `GroupViewEnabled=true`; `<leader>p` toggles
   to today's full-label view per-session.

# Why this was cheap (grounding)

- Labels are ordinal-sorted so consecutive labels share their first char
  (`src/HuntAndPeck/Services/HintLabelService.cs:52-58`) and assigned to hints
  in emission order (`OverlayViewModel.cs` LoadSession); grid points are
  emitted region-by-region, column-major within a region
  (`GenerateGridPoints` / `FillRegion` in `UiAutomationHintProviderService.cs`).
  So each first char is a spatially coherent cluster — its bounding box is a
  meaningful region.
- Prefix matching already does the drill: `ApplyMatch` narrows `Active` by
  `Label.StartsWith(_match)` and fires on a unique match, so a 1-char group
  member (sparse sessions) fires on its single char for free.
- Esc already backs out: Esc clears the prefix (`HandleEscape` → `ClearMatch`),
  which returns to the group-boxes level; Esc again closes. Continuous mode
  resets the prefix after a fire → boxes return. Zero new state machine.

# What was done (as built)

## New files

- `Services/GroupViewService.cs` (pure, unit-tested):
  - `IsGroupable(IList<Hint>, IList<string>)`: every hint is a `PointHint` AND
    at least one label is 2 chars. Automation and taskbar-merged sessions mix
    in UIA hints (tree-order labels → spatially scattered groups); an
    all-1-char session would box every point (noise).
  - `BuildGroupBoxes(IList<HintViewModel>)`: per first char, union of member
    `BoundingRectangle`s, ordered by key char. The FIRST member initializes the
    union — never `default(Rect)`, which is a degenerate rect at the ORIGIN,
    not `Rect.Empty` (a trap caught during implementation and regression-tested).
- `Models/GroupHintBox.cs` — `readonly struct { char Key; Rect Bounds; }`.

## HintCanvas

- DPs: `GroupView` (bool), `GroupBoxesSource` (IList), `GroupMatchLength`
  (int), `GroupFontSizeText` (string).
- A dedicated `DrawingVisual` (`_visuals[0]`) draws the boxes at level 1
  (`GroupView && MatchLength == 0`): one dotted rounded rect per box (round
  dash cap + `{0, 3}` dash = dots) + the key char in a small yellow pill just
  inside the top-left corner. Every hint pill renders nothing at level 1.
- Level 2 (`GroupView && MatchLength > 0`): matching hints render at their
  usual positions with `Label.Substring(MatchLength)` as the text (cached per
  index; cache cleared on length/session/DPI change); non-matching hints are
  hidden unconditionally (regardless of `HideInactive`).
- Guards added during implementation: `ParseGroupBoxes` skips text building
  until the label typeface exists (the boxes binding can pull before the hints
  binding on initial attach — `BuildFormatted` re-parses once the typeface is
  set); DPI change rebuilds group texts and clears the suffix cache.

## OverlayViewModel

- `_groupViewConfigured` (from `GroupViewEnabled`, read once per overlay, full
  ctor only) initializes `_groupViewOn`; `_groupable` (session capability,
  independent of the toggle) and `_groupBoxes` recompute per `LoadSession`
  (monitor / layout / quadrant switches each load a session).
- Bindables: `GroupView`, `GroupBoxes`, `MatchLength` (notified alongside
  `MatchString` in `AppendLabelChar` / `ClearMatch` / `LoadSession`),
  `GroupFontSize` (`GroupFontSize` config, falls back to the label size).
- `ToggleGroupView()` — `<leader>p`; no-op in zone phases (zones have their own
  drill UX — group view must not nest inside a zone lens) and for
  non-groupable sessions; flips the flag, `ClearMatch()`, rebuilds boxes.
- `LeaderCommand` case for the new `LeaderKind.ToggleGroupView`.

## Config / leader

- `GroupViewEnabled` (bool, hot-reload, default **true**) and `GroupFontSize`
  (px, hot-reload, default 14; `0` = follow `HintFontSize`) — `App.config`,
  `OverlayActionConfig.ReadGroupViewEnabled` / `ReadGroupFontSize`, the Options
  dialog (checkbox + textbox).
- `LeaderKind.ToggleGroupView`, tokens `GroupView`/`Groups`, default key `'P'`,
  display "toggle group view". The shipped `LeaderBindings` value gained
  `p=GroupView` (explicit value shadows code defaults — both updated, the
  b5eab8e lesson).
- Zone ctor untouched (zones ignore group view).

## Tests

- `GroupViewServiceTest` (9 tests): groupability (PointHint-only, non-PointHint
  excluded, all-1-char excluded, null/mismatch), box building (grouping, union,
  ordering, single-member-not-stretched-to-origin, empty-label skip).
- `LeaderBindingConfigTest`: shipped value parses to 11 bindings including
  `P = ToggleGroupView`; `Groups` alias; default fallback contains P; display
  label.
- `OverlayViewModelTest.GroupView_GridSession_DefaultsOn_AndToggles`: constructs
  a 40-PointHint session, asserts on-by-default, box count == distinct label
  first chars, toggle off (boxes null) → on (boxes back). Safe: `ClearMatch`
  path never reaches a unique match.

# Deviations from the original plan

- Zone-phase guard on `ToggleGroupView` (planned implicitly; made explicit).
- Typeface-null guard + `BuildFormatted` re-parse (not in the plan; found while
  reasoning about WPF initial binding order).
- `_groupFontSize` cache invalidation on session/font-size change (not in the
  plan).
